title: FreeCAD 1.1.4 macOS ARM64 PATH-discovered DWG open and insert qualification for a bounded 2D LINE profile
scope: End-to-end FreeCAD Draft DWG open() and insert() using the installed C++ DXF importer, PATH-discovered build-gcc/dwg2dxf, isolated FreeCAD preferences, and a bounded AC1015 three-LINE control. This is consumer-route evidence only; it does not qualify full DWG/DXF support or 3D semantics.

controlGeneration.purpose: The tracked source is also retained as a negative strict-conversion control: its third LINE references absent reactor/XDICTIONARY targets, so it is not suitable as a positive whole-document consumer input.
controlGeneration.policy: Generated only under /private/tmp; no DWG or DXF fixture was added to the repository.
controlGeneration.transformation: Read the tracked DWG with dwgread -v5 -O JSON. In the scratch JSON only, remove the reactors and xdicobjhandle properties from the LINE whose JSON handle is [0,1,50]; leave all three line endpoint pairs unchanged. Write the JSON with dwgwrite -I JSON -y -o <scratch.dwg> <scratch.json>. This creates a scratch control with no unresolved references on the 2D witness entities; it is not a committed fixture and is not a claim about source-format completeness.

consumer.importer: FreeCAD Draft importer using the C++ DXF backend

negativeResult.reason: The original third LINE references absent reactor/XDICTIONARY targets; strict graph preflight refused the conversion at handle 0x38 and did not publish a DXF.
negativeResult.meaning: The qualification did not weaken graph validation to obtain a positive result.

limitations: One AC1015 three-LINE profile only; no broad DWG/DXF support claim follows.
macOS ARM64 only; native Linux and Windows FreeCAD qualification remains open.
The control removes unresolved references from the third LINE in scratch JSON before re-encoding; it does not qualify those original graph edges.
No LibreCAD or LibreCAD_3 runtime was exercised in this slice.
No 3D/ACIS/ACDS geometry or semantic evaluation was exercised.
No testing DWG/DXF fixture was committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: MacOS ARM64 FreeCAD Draft open() and insert() PATH route with exact converter attribution and endpoint-level semantic checks for the bounded 2D LINE profile.
planImpact.remaining: P8 remains OPEN for LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3, native Linux/Windows FreeCAD, 3D consumers, ABI/API, packaging and release gates.
